items.title: DECISION NEEDED: the rational-point hypothesis, and the blueprint describing an abandoned route.
DECIDED: etale-sheafify — no rational-point binder on the headline
Wire the headline to the infrastructure

commits.subject: build(imports): wave 2 lands green — 8 modules narrowed, 25 restored, net 86 to 64 bare
commits.summary:
**Green, measured.** `Build completed successfully (8723 jobs)` — 0 errors, 25:59.79 wall, 8.3 GB peak. Warning heads 26: the 24 honest `sorry` notices plus two `unusedSectionVars` in GrassmannianZariskiSheaf that had been masked until that file was rebuilt; fixing them exposed a third, and all three now carry the `omit [IsLocallyNoetherian S] in` the linter asked for — the convention that file already used 21 times. It re-elaborates with zero output.

**The honest arithmetic.** Wave 2 narrowed 8 modules (including QuotScheme, the 804-second hotspot, to 13 precise imports) but stripped the library from 25 that declare no imports of their own, so the day nets 86 to 64 bare, not to 39 as an intermediate count suggested. Narrowing `StructureSheafModuleK/Presheaf.lean` alone cost nine modules up the `StructureSheafModuleK -> Genus -> Jacobian` chain.

**Method corrected.** Bottom-up is right for probe accuracy and wrong for net progress: give a modules import-less dependents their own precise imports first, top-down within the cone, then narrow the parent. The exposure is computable from the import graph — elaborate every module that declares no Mathlib import in parallel with `lake env lean` before converting, not after. Of 54 such modules, exactly 24 need Mathlib; the other 30 were loading 1.79 GB of oleans for nothing.

commits.subject: roadmap(ajc): record the import-campaign ordering rule that wave 2 disproved
commits.summary:
Bottom-up conversion is correct for probe accuracy but net-negative whenever a module has a cone of import-less dependents: narrowing `Presheaf.lean` stripped the library from nine modules up the `StructureSheafModuleK → Genus → Jacobian` chain, and wave 2 as a whole converted 8 modules while forcing 25 back onto the umbrella (39 → 64 bare). The rule is now: give the import-less dependents their own precise imports first, top-down within the cone, then narrow the parent.

The real work item is the 54 modules that declare no Mathlib import at all — invisible to the probe because nothing in their text says what they need. Elaborating all 54 in parallel with `lake env lean` resolves the exposure in minutes where a full build finds one victim per round; exactly 24 need Mathlib and the other 30 were loading 1.79 GB of oleans for nothing.

commits.subject: fix(scripts): make each de-umbrella wave atomic — it now repairs its own cascade
commits.summary:
**The defect.** The driver build-gated between waves but treated a failed build as a warning to print and move past, so a cascade could travel into the next wave and out to the user. Three times today the same class of breakage escaped that way: 35 of this projects modules declare no Mathlib import at all, inherit the library transitively, and are invisible to the minimal-import probe because nothing in their own text says what they need.

**The fix.** `build_and_repair` now reads the broken modules straight out of the build log, restores a bare `import Mathlib` to each — which restores exactly the environment they were inheriting, so it cannot fail — and rebuilds, up to four attempts, refusing to start the next wave until the current one is green. A wave is now atomic: it lands green or repairs itself to green. The campaign can be left running unattended.

commits.subject: roadmap(ajc): collapse 41 spent housekeeping nodes so the mathematics is legible again
commits.summary:
**The legibility problem, inverted.** The AJC tree carried 70 `AJC.maintenance.*` nodes six levels deep against 56 mathematical ones, so `roadmap list --focus AJC.jacobian` rendered engineering chores at four levels of detail and ~59k lines of finished algebraic geometry as almost nothing. It is now **29 maintenance against 58 mathematical, max depth 3**.

**What was retired and why.** The 25-node `warnings.residual.*` subtree became obsolete when the last 102 mechanical warnings were cleared; that node is now one `done` item carrying the whole 1,174 → 24 arc. The Čech contractibility and resource-budget leaves recorded per-declaration benchmarks that survive in the ledger and in their parents summaries. Nothing open was lost: `explicit-carriers` stays because a deliberately ruled-out route is worth keeping, and the three genuine Čech base-change obligations were already covered by `AJC.fbc`.

commits.subject: chore(horizon): record the measured build baseline and file the two decisions for the owner
commits.summary:
I-0319 now carries the re-measured from-scratch build (43:15.98, 9.7 GB, 8,723 jobs green), the finding that the wall clock is critical-path bound rather than throughput bound, the per-file umbrella cost (16.6s/7GB vs 3.5s/2.0GB), and the correction that the 289 `backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency` scopes match upstream practice and should be left alone.

A new `to human` issue states the two questions that outrank all mechanical work: whether to étale-sheafify the Picard functor (mathlib v4.31 does have the étale topology, so the rational-point binder is a design choice, not a platform limit), and whether to re-aim the 8,434-line Quot blueprint chapter at the Milne--Kollár route the tree actually committed to on 9 July.

commits.subject: style(ajc): clear all 102 mechanical Lean warnings and 229 journal fragments from the API docs
commits.summary:
**Warnings 126 -> 24.** Every remaining head is now a genuine `declaration uses sorry`. The substantive fixes: in AuslanderBuchsbaum, nine overlapping-instance warnings cleared by dropping `[IsLocalRing R]`/`[IsNoetherianRing R]` from declarations already carrying `[IsRegularLocalRing R]` (which extends both), and eight `[Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]` weakened to `[Finite ι]` with `classical` + `letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι`, leaving nested induction-hypothesis binders intact. Elsewhere: `show` -> `change`, `omit [Inst] in`, unused simp arguments, deprecated `push_neg`/`Ideal.minimalPrimes_isPrime`, and line wrapping. No declaration statement was changed beyond those linter-directed binder weakenings, and no `sorry` was added, removed or moved.

**Documentation.** 229 development-journal fragments removed from `/--` and `/-!` docstrings, which doc-gen4 publishes as this projects API documentation — 98 in AuslanderBuchsbaum, 27 in IdentityComponent, 26 in FGAPicRepresentability, 23 in AlbaneseUP. Mathematics and genuine hypothesis caveats were kept; iteration numbers, lane/wave vocabulary, route comparisons and status sections were not.

**One honest deviation.** GlueDescents `hC1` unused-section-variable warning cannot be fixed with `omit`, because `hC1` is explicitly `include`d and `include` overrides `omit`; the linter-prescribed fix would change two statements and their call sites. It is instead suppressed for that single declaration with `set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in`, the convention already used at Cohomology/FreePresheafComplex.lean:1472 and Cohomology/CechBridge.lean:945, with the reason recorded in the source.

commits.subject: fix(imports): restore the library to StructureSheafModuleK/Presheaf
commits.summary: The second-round cascade victim: it carried no Mathlib import of its own and lost `CategoryTheory.Linear`, `Adjunction.homAddEquiv` and `HasSheafify` when its parents were narrowed. Restoring the bare `import Mathlib` restores exactly the environment it previously inherited. It is one of the 12 modules now ready for a proper precise-import conversion in wave 2.

commits.subject: fix(imports): repair the four modules that inherited Mathlib from a narrowed parent
commits.summary:
**The regression.** Wave 1 narrowed 27 import-DAG sources. Four modules carried no Mathlib import of their own and were silently inheriting one, so they lost the whole library: Cohomology/StructureSheafAb (from SheafCompose), Picard/FiniteGaloisQuotient, Picard/Pic0TangentSpace and Picard/GrassmannianQuot — 124 errors, caught by the verification build before anything was claimed green.

**The repair.** Three now carry their own precise imports (StructureSheafAb 5, Pic0TangentSpace 6, FiniteGaloisQuotient 3). GrassmannianQuot resisted: with narrowed imports it times out at `isDefEq` (:924) and `whnf` (:1217) at the default 200,000 heartbeats, so `deumbrella.sh` restored its umbrella automatically. Narrowing is therefore NOT always free — a smaller environment can send a defeq check down a different, slower path — and that is exactly why every conversion re-elaborates the file and reverts on failure.

**Process fix.** A source must be converted together with its dependents that import no Mathlib of their own, and every wave must end with a full build before the next begins — which is what `scripts/deumbrella-wave.sh` does and what running wave 1 as a raw parallel loop skipped.

commits.subject: roadmap(ajc): record the unwired headline, the sorried instances, and the rational-point decision
commits.summary: **Three findings from an adversarially-verified six-front assessment.** (1) `AJC.picrep.rigidpushforward` was marked done earlier today; that was wrong and is now `pending` — RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean:1386-1388 says in its own docstring that the `HasRigidPushforward` gate is not instantiated because its `baseChange` field is still open. (2) `Jacobian.lean` imports only `Genus`, so none of the 122k lines of Picard/Albanese/Cohomology work is reachable from `picardJacobianWitness`, and two `sorry`-bodied *instances* (`instHasPicScheme` at FGAPicRepresentability.lean:317, `pullback_preservesFiniteLimits` at CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean:163) leak through typeclass synthesis — so "153 sorry-free modules" is a local claim, not an axiom-cleanliness one. (3) The rational-point hypothesis is a design decision, not a platform limit: mathlib v4.31 does carry the étale topology.
